title: I Built a 50-Floor Dubai Skyscraper Concept With AI

phrases.speak: I built this fifty-floor Dubai skyscraper concept with AI. Here is how it really happened.
phrases.show: I built this 50-floor Dubai skyscraper concept with AI. Here is how it really happened.

phrases.speak: It started with an idea. A twisting glass tower on the Dubai coast. A fictional site, inspired by Jumeirah. Not a real plot.
phrases.show: It started with an idea. A twisting glass tower on the Dubai coast. A fictional site, inspired by Jumeirah. Not a real plot.

phrases.speak: Then I briefed Claude Code. Fifty floors. A glass skin. Landscaping. And real interiors.
phrases.show: Then I briefed Claude Code. 50 floors. A glass skin. Landscaping. And real interiors.

phrases.speak: Claude Code wrote the project as Python scripts for Blender. The height, the ninety-six degree twist, even the seventy-two bronze fins, are just numbers in a file.
phrases.show: Claude Code wrote the project as Python scripts for Blender. The height, the 96-degree twist, even the 72 bronze fins, are just numbers in a file.

phrases.speak: Run the build, and in under a second Blender creates the whole scene. More than eighteen hundred objects, with no manual modeling.
phrases.show: Run the build, and in under a second Blender creates the whole scene. More than 1,800 objects, with no manual modeling.

phrases.speak: Then the cameras take over. A glass facade that twists as you rise. Palm trees. A grand arrival court.
phrases.show: Then the cameras take over. A glass facade that twists as you rise. Palm trees. A grand arrival court.

phrases.speak: And the same tower, inside. A lobby. An office floor. An apartment. And a duplex penthouse with a feature stair.
phrases.show: And the same tower, inside. A lobby. An office floor. An apartment. And a duplex penthouse with a feature stair.

phrases.speak: By my own count, the first concept took about thirty minutes of prompting. Rendering the film took a few hours. And it is only a concept. Not approved. Not built.
phrases.show: By my own count, the first concept took about 30 minutes of prompting. Rendering the film took a few hours. And it is only a concept. Not approved. Not built.

phrases.speak: This is what AI-assisted creation really looks like. Follow Agentoon dot A I, for more real AI experiments.
